about: Whose notes each of Starcom's layers reads by default, and the keys each of those publishers signs with. A reading choice, published so anyone can see it and change it by changing this file: not a register of who may publish, and it gives no weight to anyone's claims (refusal R-1). A key's 'starts' is the day it begins to speak for its publisher, by the publisher's own word; a key with none has not begun. 'exposed' is the day its secret got out: nothing is sealed to it, and once a newer key of its publisher starts, nothing it signed is read. Layers read 'every key' of a publisher, or only its 'newest key' (the first listed).

keys.note: The next key (decision K4-N), sent before anything is signed with it. Its start is set here once Mecha Jono's standing notes have been carried to it.
The first key. Exposed on 28 Sep 2026, by Mecha Jono's own key-change letter of 7 Oct, as NavCom's publisher registry records it; its start is NavCom's.
